decisions.reason: Given the firm's two-year public commitment and sunk investments in this biodynamic yogurt range, and because it is close to the established offer, management will likely persist rather than drop it.
The product's own webpage signals visible public commitment and the firm has already invested in its launch, so escalation of commitment makes early withdrawal unlikely.
Similarly, the firm has publicly committed to this sliced butter cheese and will likely keep it to justify the launch and avoid admitting failure.
